scopes.ported: Compute test project of the port. A frozen coverage contract classifies each of its cases; the cases run on the original Windows WARP baseline and through the live host adapter on every translated target profile.
scopes.windows-specific: Direct3D 12 device-lifetime, COM or native-library packaging test project. It depends on Windows-only interfaces with no translated-target equivalent and stays with the upstream Windows CI.
scopes.cpu-only: Host-side test project that never creates a device. It verifies the unchanged C# source generators and analyzers, which the port consumes as they are.
scopes.out-of-scope: Direct2D, WinUI or NuGet package project. The port covers the compute runtime only, not Direct2D effects, WinUI or package publishing.

ComputeSharp.D2D1.Tests.reason: Direct2D pixel-shader effects through ID2D1Effect (ComputeSharp.D2D1), not the compute runtime.

ComputeSharp.D2D1.Tests.AssemblyLevelAtt.reason: Assembly-level options of the Direct2D shader generator (ComputeSharp.D2D1).

ComputeSharp.D2D1.Tests.SourceGenerators.reason: Diagnostics of the Direct2D shader generator (ComputeSharp.D2D1.SourceGenerators).

ComputeSharp.D2D1.WinUI.Tests.reason: Win2D and WinUI integration of Direct2D effects; runs as a packaged WinAppSDK application under VS Test.

ComputeSharp.D2D1.WinUI.Tests.SourceGene.reason: Diagnostics of the WinUI Direct2D effect generator; runs as a WinAppSDK test under VS Test.

ComputeSharp.Dxc.NuGet.reason: Consumes the published ComputeSharp.Dxc package with win-x64 native DXC binaries to verify packaging, including NativeAOT publishing.
upstreamSteps: verify-packages: Publish and run ComputeSharp.Dxc.NuGet with NativeAOT

ComputeSharp.NuGet.reason: Consumes the published ComputeSharp package on win-x64 to verify packaging, including NativeAOT publishing.
upstreamSteps: verify-packages: Publish and run ComputeSharp.NuGet with NativeAOT

ComputeSharp.Pix.NuGet.reason: Consumes the published ComputeSharp.Pix package, which loads the Windows PIX capture library, to verify packaging.
upstreamSteps: verify-packages: Publish and run ComputeSharp.Pix.NuGet with NativeAOT

ComputeSharp.Tests.reason: The upstream compute functional tests: buffers, textures, dispatch, shader features, resource ordering and image processing.

variants.run-tests-d3d12ma: Run ComputeSharp.Test: Reruns the same cases with UseD3D12MemoryAllocator=true, which only selects the Direct3D 12 Memory Allocator inside the Direct3D 12 runtime. The baseline runs the default allocator; translated targets have their own allocators.

ComputeSharp.Tests.DeviceLost.reason: Removes the device through ID3D12Device5::RemoveDevice and checks ID3D12Device COM reference counts and DXGI device-lost notifications.

ComputeSharp.Tests.DisableDynamicCompila.reason: References only the precompiled shader runtime, without ComputeSharp.Dynamic, and dispatches a compute shader over a float buffer and a pixel shader (IComputeShader<float4>) over an RGBA8 UNORM texture.

ComputeSharp.Tests.GlobalStatements.reason: Top-level program that dispatches a compute shader declared next to global statements and compares the buffer with the same function evaluated on the CPU.

ComputeSharp.Tests.Internals.reason: Debugger views of device buffers and textures, generated dispatch-data loaders over device resources, and host-side helpers of the runtime that it reaches through InternalsVisibleTo.

suite.noFloatArithmeticReason: The Internals shaders exist to exercise generated dispatch-data loaders; their bodies only compare the thread ids with the dispatch size, so no artifact does float arithmetic.

ComputeSharp.Tests.NativeLibrariesResolv.reason: Publishes apps against the NuGet packages and checks that the win-x64 native DXC and PIX libraries resolve for each publishing mode.

ComputeSharp.Tests.SourceGenerators.reason: Roslyn tests of the compute shader descriptor generator and analyzers: generated sources, diagnostics and incrementality, with no device.
